description: This file implements a file system adapter for storage operations, providing methods to read, write, check existence, create directories, and list directory contents.

classes.name: DefaultFileSystemAdapter
classes.description: A struct implementing FileSystemAdapter interface to interact with the file system.

methods.name: NewFileSystemAdapter
methods.description: Constructor function returning a new instance of DefaultFileSystemAdapter.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file at the given path.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file at the specified path with permissions 0644.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory exists at the given path.

methods.name: CreateDirectory
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parents at the given path with permissions 0755.

methods.name: ListDirectory
methods.description: Lists the contents of the directory at the specified path.
